task_definition.task_description: Please reserve 1 black Sony WH-1000XM5 for me and generate an invoice to alice@example.com for payment, then check for similar electronics options, pick an alternative, hold the silver Sony WH-1000XM5 instead, and confirm that order. After that, look up Hilton Tokyo, book a deluxe room for Alice Johnson from 2026-01-01 to 2026-01-03, then check my available coupons, apply the best discount to the headphone purchase, and place the order with my credit card. Finally, find Alice’s HR contact details, create a high-priority email summary titled “Travel and Purchase Summary” with the shopping and travel info, and then send me an instant message confirming the notification was sent.

user_input.query: Please help me with a shopping and travel summary. In the electronics category, reserve 1 black Sony WH-1000XM5 using product_id p_sony_xm5_blk and quantity 1 from my items list [{product_id: p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity: 1}], and generate an invoice to alice@example.com for payment. Then check for similar electronics options, choose an alternative, hold the silver Sony WH-1000XM5 instead, and confirm that order. After that, look up Hilton Tokyo and book a deluxe room for Alice Johnson from 2026-01-01 to 2026-01-03. Also check my available coupons, including coupon_code SAVE15, apply the best discount to the headphone purchase, and place the order using stripe with my credit_card. My user_id is u_alice, contact_name is alice, channel is email, priority is high, and tags are shopping, travel, and summary. Finally, find Alice’s HR contact details, create a high-priority email titled “Travel and Purchase Summary” with all the shopping and travel details, and then send me an instant message confirming the notification was sent.
